common.artifact_fidelity_rule: Check every fixed semantic ID, path, type, graph relation and unrelated-content invariant against independent references, plus source version and full file-set diff. Unexplained extra object/file changes are incorrect; missing reference/version evidence is unverified; no-op behavior change is incorrect. Byte identity is required for unrelated files unless frozen exceptions explicitly allow changes; within changed binaries use independent native object/property maps, not byte equality alone. No blanket resave-noise exception.
common.answer_rule: Reuse protocol required claims, extras and contradiction rules. Writing claims cite original hash/locator plus corresponding output hash/locator; creation cites requirement anchor plus new artifact locator. Correct prose cannot compensate for a missing/wrong artifact; a correct artifact cannot compensate for unsupported prose.
common.native_rule: Separate load-without-broken-arrow, compile/build, controlled behavior and target execution records, each with actual environment, version, inputs/errors and hashed logs. No runtime means unexecuted, never passed. A load is not a run; simulation is not hardware validation.
common.denominators: Freeze artifact semantic IDs and preservation IDs separately from answer IDs and reading probe IDs; retain every ID and planned case under all limitations. Report planned/attempted/artifact-produced/inspected/native-executed/scored/complete-pair counts separately, plus unexpected edits and extras. No combined quality score or new threshold.
